snippet.title: Absolum | Nintendo Switch 2 Physical Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Pre-Order Now! https://direct.silverliningint.com/search?q=absolum+nintendo+switch&options%5Bprefix%5D=last

Fight as the outcast heroes of Talamh in a fierce battle to retake magic from Sun King Azra’s grasp in Absolum, an original roguelite beat ‘em up by Dotemu.
